findings.catchup_target: the same per-trajectory clipped return used by the standard critic update
findings.mechanism_localization: H8 did not leak actor/trunk updates. It added repeated squared-error value-head fitting on the same noisy on-policy return targets after KL stopped joint epochs.
findings.observed_fixed_sample_effect: Both internal mirrors strongly improved while primary and anchor critic calibration clearly worsened; KL stability also failed.
findings.robust_loss_candidate_scope: Change only catch-up loss from MSE to a preregistered robust regression loss; leave standard PPO critic loss, targets, actor/trunk, target-KL, optimizer, epochs, deal stream and all other config unchanged.
findings.scale_selection_risk: A robust-loss beta chosen by searching H8 holdout outcomes would be post-hoc. H9 requires one fixed scale justified independently before registration or must remain engineering-only.
